decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's core plural-component spraying line for corrosion protection, a durable niche where it has engineering strength.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own web page and documented field use in construction repair, so it is an established offer worth keeping.
This multi-model transfer pump line reuses the proven WIWA air motors and serves the core material-conveying business, so dropping it is unlikely.
Fire protection flow monitoring has its own web page and supports the firm's digitalized process-control goals, although it is somewhat further from the core pump business.
The hydraulic two-component sprayer was launched recently, is close to the core offer, and needs time on the market.
